summary: iter5 tested iLoveWorks rebrand + Privacy page + Delete-my-account + Clock-out admin alert + Idle worker-status fields. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass against deployed REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (branding endpoints, worker-status is_idle/idle_minutes, worker_clock_out notification, DELETE /api/me flow incl. 401 wrong-pw / 403 admin / 200 correct / login-fails-post-delete / worker vanishes from admin worker-status). Frontend: public /privacy loads unauthenticated with 9 sections, gold iLoveWorks wordmark, back-to-sign-in link works. Login page shows gold wordmark and login-privacy-link. Throwaway-worker end-to-end delete flow: Profile → Danger zone → delete-account-btn opens dialog; wrong password shows 'Incorrect password' toast; correct password deletes account, shows 'Account deleted. Goodbye 👋' toast, and redirects to /login. Admin profile shows admin-delete-note and no delete-account-btn. Admin notification bell renders 'X clocked out — working · Xm' entries without crash.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/me does thorough cleanup (tasks, time_entries, goals owned + collaborator pull, essentials owned + collaborator pull, notifications, awards, push_subscriptions, peer_access both directions, soft-delete files) and clears auth cookies — correct App Store deletion semantics.
worker_clock_out notify wrapped in try/except so a notify failure never breaks clock-out — good defensive pattern.
admin_worker_status is_idle/idle_minutes computed from last activity; idle_minutes is None when not idle — matches frontend expectations. IDLE_ALERT_MINUTES=10.
GET /api/notifications returns {items, unread} envelope (not a bare list). Any test/script relying on `notifications` key will get []; frontend NotificationBell already handles this correctly.
server.py is now ~2826 lines; still over the 700-line guideline. Splitting into routers remains a maintainability nit, not blocking.
Manifest short_name and API root message both updated to 'iLoveWorks' — rebrand is consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (privacy, login branding, delete-account worker E2E, admin profile note, notification bell)

test_credentials: Admin admin@clockwork.com/admin123 (never deleted), Worker lovetest@loveworks.com/Love123! (preserved). Throwaway workers deltest_<ts>@loveworks.com/Delete123! and deltest_ui@loveworks.com/Delete123! were created via POST /api/workers and both deleted during tests.
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates a unique deltest_<timestamp>@loveworks.com worker per run and deletes it via DELETE /api/me. Frontend flow used deltest_ui@loveworks.com — that worker is now deleted. No lingering TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iloveworks_iter5.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter5.xml (~6s). Worker Profile route is /worker/profile (click 'Profile' tab, don't navigate to /profile). GET /api/notifications returns {items:[...], unread:N}, not a bare list. DELETE /api/me expects JSON body {password} — use requests.request('DELETE', url, json=...) or axios.delete(url,{data:{password}}). Idle alert itself requires 10 min of inactivity to fire — only the is_idle/idle_minutes fields on /api/admin/worker-status were verified, not the alert notification.
